decisions.reason: The BOM state already requires smaller, thinner whisks in the client-referenced style for fine powder, so another MODIFY would duplicate existing state.
Selecting a whisk style for fine-powder mixing does not necessarily change the existing splash-control target.
The source selects a whisk style and does not change the established 2.5-quart bowl capacity, depth, or enclosure-size constraints.
Whisk style selection does not alter the requirement that bowls be quickly removable and swappable.
The source concerns the whisk component, not removal, flushing, or cleaning of the dispensing path.
The whisk reference does not change valve operation, dripping constraints, or dispensing flow behavior.
The source does not change enclosure thickness, overall size, or accommodation of the bowl wells.
Whisk style selection has no necessary effect on the established plumbing and bowl-bottom sealing requirements.
The source does not concern or change the machine placard text.
Although adjacent context discusses the spout, the source decision itself only establishes a whisk-style reference and does not change spout geometry or orientation.
Whisk style selection does not affect the beige body or green accent color requirements.
The selected whisk style does not necessarily change the requirement to prevent liquid from reaching electrical components.
